In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we propose a multi-task trained retriever which is robust across a wide variety of knowledge-intensive tasks, even when trained with few examples.
our model outperforms previous state of the art models on a wide variety and diverse set of retrieval and downstream tasks.
we propose a multi-task neural retrieval model, which outperforms previous approaches on a variety of tasks and is competitive even when in domain data is available.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we show that a multi task trained neural retriever is able to perform competitively with specialised neural models, and can be applied to many different tasks with a few examples.
we have developed a universal retriever that can be trained in a few shots and can outperform specialised retrievers trained with large amounts of in domain data.
a single model can be trained to retrieve relevant contexts for a large variety of knowledge intensive tasks, and can be used to improve existing models for these tasks.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a single model can learn to perform well across a wide variety of retrieval tasks.
multi task training of neural retrievers can be a powerful approach for building robust and general models that can be deployed on many different tasks.
a multi task trained retrieval model is a strong baseline for many knowledge intensive tasks, and can be used as a building block for future systems.
